packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/runtime_.name: Run control
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/runtime_.description: Lets an agent check its status, wait, go quiet, and work with boards and tickets.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/schema.p.name: Tool input checking
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/schema.p.description: Checks a tool call's inputs and trims redundant labels, without exposing the submitted values or secrets.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/scratchp.name: Scratchpad (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/scratchp.description: Lets an agent read and write its scratchpad notes.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/search.p.name: Search (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/search.p.description: Lets an agent search its own memory and the threads it takes part in, and search and fetch pages from the web.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/secrets..name: Secrets (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/secrets..description: Lets an agent list and delete the owner's workspace secrets from chat, only on the owner's own request.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/session_.name: Session search (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/session_.description: Lets an agent search within a session.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/skill_ac.name: Skill access
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/skill_ac.description: Gives an agent read access to its own instruction catalog, without granting it as a tool.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/skills.p.name: Skills (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/skills.p.description: Lets an agent view, save, import, validate and restore its skills.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/source_t.name: Trust a source
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/source_t.description: Trusts a source only on the owner's own typed words, with no card shown.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/subagent.name: Helpers (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/subagent.description: Lets an agent spawn a temporary helper and inspect it.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/supervis.name: Lead controls (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/supervis.description: Lets Lonora, as the lead, read and steer its team agents: cancel their runs, switch them to Ask, or delete them.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/symbols..name: Symbol resolving
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/symbols..description: Turns a symbol request into the account's own spelling of it, or asks which one when it is unclear.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/tasks.py.name: Tasks (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/tasks.py.description: Lets an agent start, inspect, control and wait on its tasks, and record each step.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/telegram.name: Link Telegram (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/telegram.description: Links the owner's Telegram chat from chat, only when the owner sends the code himself.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/terminal.name: Workspace terminal (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/terminal.description: Lets an agent use the owner's workspace — run commands, read and write files, manage processes — with every byte that comes back scanned for secrets.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/tool_dis.name: Tool discovery
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/tool_dis.description: Ranks an agent's permitted tools to help it find the right one.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/tool_res.name: Saved tool results
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/tool_res.description: Keeps private, size-bounded copies of tool results in the file store.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/trade.py.name: Trading (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/trade.py.description: The agent's trading actions — open, manage and close positions — gated by the owner's approval cards and the broker's own confirmation.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/trading_.name: Trading decisions (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/trading_.description: Records the evidence behind a trading decision once, so past choices can be explained without re-reading today's market.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/usage.py.name: Usage (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/usage.py.description: Lets an agent read the owner's model usage in chat.

packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/workspac.name: Export a file (tool)
packages/tools/src/lonora_tools/workspac.description: Delivers a file from the owner's workspace into the chat as a real attachment.
